prompt: Review and fix the design of my app at http://localhost:3000.
expected_output: Runs audit.py into the resolved workspace, writes a prioritized critique tied to visual evidence, applies scoped fixes, and verifies desktop/mobile screenshots.
expectations: Runs scripts/audit.py with WORKSPACE/ux-audit as output
Evaluates hierarchy, spacing, typography, color, alignment, responsiveness, overflow, and affordances
Writes ux-audit/design-critique.md with screenshot paths or computed CSS evidence
Re-captures desktop and mobile screenshots after changes

prompt: Audit only http://localhost:5173/dashboard for responsive layout and typography problems.
expected_output: Passes the dashboard route to audit.py, limits findings and fixes to that route, and verifies responsive screenshots.
expectations: Keeps critique and edits scoped to dashboard
Verifies no overlap or overflow after fixes

prompt: Report only: critique http://localhost:3000 but do not change source files.
expected_output: Produces the audit artifacts and evidence-backed critique without modifying app source.
expectations: Does not modify CSS or component files
Clearly identifies recommended fixes as un-applied

prompt: How do I center a div?
expected_output: Answers the isolated CSS question directly without launching a rendered UX audit.
expectations: Does not launch Playwright or audit.py

prompt: Find and fix all functional bugs in my checkout flow.
expected_output: Does not invoke the visual-design skill; routes browser workflow QA to frontend-twerkin.
expectations: Does not run a visual-only audit
Identifies frontend-twerkin as the relevant workflow
